scripts.title: UNC Test
scripts.features:
Improved UNC Environment Checker – Reworked version that tests way more stuff than the normal UNC test.
It safely checks most executor features (closures, crypt, debug, filesystem, HTTP, mouse/input, drawing, WebSocket, etc.), actually uses them instead of just checking if they exist, and shows a clear console summary with pass/fail counts, missing functions, and an overall “how UNC-compatible is your exploit” verdict. Optional rconsole tests can be triggered via a Roblox notification so buggy rconsole implementations don’t insta-crash your executor.
